_meta.description: Machine-readable leave rules for deterministic code (the rules engine behind preview_leave_request). The LLM explains results; it never computes them. Every value cites the clause it encodes, and a unit test must check each value against the policy text so the two cannot drift apart.

part_time.value: entitlement x fte, rounded down to the nearest half day

notice.counting: min_notice_working_days counts working days strictly between the submission date and the first day of leave. min_notice_calendar_days = first_day - submission_date, in calendar days.

balance.value: remaining = annual_entitled - annual_taken - annual_pending; a request larger than remaining is blocked (suggest unpaid leave, §5.4)

severity_meanings.blocking: The request cannot be prepared. Explain the rule and the alternatives.
severity_meanings.needs_extra_approval: A draft may be prepared only if the user explicitly chooses to proceed; the violation and the extra approver are attached to the request.
